name: archgen
description: Monorepo root for archgen — scripts only. Not published; the CLI publishes as archgen-skill and the extension ships as a .vsix from GitHub Releases.
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspaces root: packages/cli is zero-dep and
packages/extension manages its own committed lockfile + native rebuild
(better-sqlite3). Workspaces would hoist/merge lockfiles and break the
extension's `npm ci` contract. Use `npm run setup` once after cloning,
then `npm test` runs every suite CI runs.
Extension tests require Node 22 (jsdom + better-sqlite3 + vitest pools);
the MCP server and skill require Node >= 20 (the official MCP SDK v2 does).
No `version` field on purpose: archgen.config.json is the single version
source (CI vendor-check gates every derived copy). A root version here
would be an ungated drift source.

scripts.test: npm run test:internal && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:cli && npm run test:extension
scripts.test:extension: npm --prefix packages/extension run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/extension run compile && npm --prefix packages/extension test
scripts.test:fixtures: npm --prefix packages/mcp ci --no-audit --no-fund && bash fixtures/greenfield-demo/run.sh && bash fixtures/brownfield-demo/run.sh && bash fixtures/verifier-negative/run.sh && bash fixtures/tool-matrix/run.sh
